metadata.method_name: W05w -- sliding-layer-window generalisation of the pooled abliteration weight scar, with a pre-registered eligibility filter and a threshold-brittleness audit
metadata.baseline_name: W05 (pooled Gram minimum-layer write energy), vendored unchanged from the iteration-3 archive
metadata.description:
Windowed weight scan: can narrowing the pool see the edits the pooled scar misses?

THREE ARMS, tensor-only, prompt-free, zero forward passes, $0.00 OpenRouter.

  ARM 1  W05w, a sliding-layer-window generalisation of the pooled statistic W05,
         against the exact edits W05 provably cannot see (band-limited,
         depth-weighted, per-head, sub-unit-weight), with k=L reproducing W05 to
         float tolerance as a built-in gate.
  ARM 2  a PRE-REGISTERED, hash-stamped eligibility rule, re-derived on the
         archived 160-repo undeclared scan and extended with newly fetched
         eligible repos, giving a false-positive rate on a FILTERED denominator.
  ARM 3  threshold brittleness of the panel-fitted operating point.

Stages:  gate -> arm1 -> arm2 -> arm3 -> numbers   (`--stage all` runs them in order)

raw.name: the archived 0/160, recomputed on the UNFILTERED scored population
raw.note: computed on a population that includes unit-test fixtures, speculator heads, quantized re-uploads and mis-indexed >4.2B repos

arithmetic.note: pure arithmetic: W05 = log10(min(e_v1)) recomputed from the per-matrix energies the archive stored; zero downloads, zero re-decoding, so any delta on the PRIMARY source (scan.jsonl, full precision) is a bookkeeping error, not dtype drift.
arithmetic.ladder_root_caveat: ladder.jsonl and root.json store e_v1 ROUNDED TO TWO SIGNIFICANT FIGURES (values such as 2.7e-05), so their deltas are a storage-precision artefact and are reported separately rather than folded into the gate.

kL_equals_W05.compared_against: W05_f64 (the pooled minimum energy evaluated in float64 along the same eigenvector)
kL_equals_W05.f32_note: on an EXACT synthetic rank-one annihilation the residual energy is ~1e-13, i.e. pure float32 cancellation noise, so the vendored float32 pooled value and the float64 value differ by ~1e-2 in log10 there; on real checkpoints e_v1 ~ 1e-5 and the gap collapses (reported per model).

four_of_twelve_injection.blind_spot_criterion: W02 < 0.05, i.e. the pooled direction-consistency statistic does not fire -- this is the archived finding being reproduced
four_of_twelve_injection.cos_note: the archive describes v1 as 'no longer the injected direction at all'; measured here the pooled minimum eigenvector retains PARTIAL alignment with the injected direction, so the correct statement is that the pooled statistic stops firing while the direction is still partly visible, not that it vanishes

arm1.panel_note: G1 is the 20 control checkpoints the archived scan carries (8 abliterated, 12 clean), NOT the full iteration-2 44-member panel, whose per-member W05 values are not stored in any archive file reachable from this workspace.

w05w_panel_fitted_thresholds.definition: the MAXIMUM W05w over the 8 abliterated control checkpoints -- exactly the construction that produced the pooled operating point -2.7415117804288127 (the weakest positive defines the boundary). Panel-fitted, never validated out of panel, and CIRCULAR for sensitivity measured on those same 8 members.

leave_one_recipe_class_out.design: PRIMARY generalisation control: each recipe class is scored by a threshold that never saw it (the shared pooled operating point is fitted on R1-class huihui checkpoints only; the panel-fitted W05w thresholds are fitted on CLEAN models only, so no edit class is in either fit).
leave_one_recipe_class_out.secondary: leave-one-uploader-out (uploader is a weaker grouping than recipe)

counts.stale_claim_check: the hypothesis records '65 vs 81 UNRESOLVED' as stale in one artifact; counted from the rows themselves the non-control UNRESOLVED tally is reported above

primary.name: false-positive rate of the pooled W05 certificate on the FILTERED eligible undeclared population

secondary_raw_unfiltered.name: the archived 0/160, recomputed on the UNFILTERED scored population
secondary_raw_unfiltered.note: computed on a population that includes unit-test fixtures, speculator heads, quantized re-uploads and mis-indexed >4.2B repos

eligibility_stamp.rule: E1 n_layers>=8; E2 hidden_size>=128; E3 params<=4.2e9 enforced twice (index AND on-disk bytes / widest dtype); E4 not a unit-test fixture; E5 not a speculator/draft head; E6 not a quantized re-upload

arm3.threshold_provenance: panel-fitted on 44 checkpoints; never validated out of panel; operating value -2.7415117804288127; panel margin 0.0763 log10 carried by two individual checkpoints (huihui-ai/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-abliterated at -2.7415117804288127 and allenai/OLMo-1B-hf at -2.665194698505143)

archive_cross_check.note: the archive names rinna/japanese-gpt-neox-small (-2.614) and stabilityai/stablelm-3b-4e1t (-2.515) as the two closest undeclared checkpoints, and allenai/OLMo-1B-hf (-2.6652) as the nearest non-abliterated panel neighbour; the values below are recomputed from the archived rows, and any delta is reported rather than the archived number being repeated

predictions_stated_before_running.P1: W05w with k in {4,6} catches the middle-50% band edit that W05 misses (log10 e drops by > 1.0 in the edited windows).
predictions_stated_before_running.P2: W05w catches mlabonne-Gaussian and Heretic depth-weighted kernels at some k, with catch-rate increasing as k shrinks toward the kernel's effective support.
predictions_stated_before_running.P3: W05w MISSES ORBA/Householder at every k (a reflection leaves no null direction).
predictions_stated_before_running.P4: Specificity DECREASES monotonically as k decreases; the frontier has a knee.
predictions_stated_before_running.P5: Sub-unit-weight uniform edits (w = 0.25..0.9) are caught by BOTH W05 and W05w with monotone degradation in w.

P1.reason: band or parent variant not run

P4.note: monotone means specificity is non-decreasing as k grows, i.e. non-increasing as k shrinks
